row.notes: Frontend scene setup that needs a 0x4ee00+ byte stack. For the scene description at self+0xd0 it walks std::map slot tables (+0x50, +0xb0, +0xf8, and feature-flag gated +0x180 / +0x200) and replaces each u16 car id with Game_FrontendSceneManager_FindOrCreateNewCustomCar(self+0x30). Then for each entry of the source maps (+0xe0 team via self+0x38 table, +0x20 entrants, +0x98 drivers, +0x150, +0x1d0) it resolves the entity (Sess_ResolveEntityHandle on self+0x40), builds spawn params and a vehicle customisation (FUN_1428c1530, Game_VehicleCustomisation_Copy, variant name table 0x14588eb30 with 3 entries) and applies it to the custom car with 0x1428ec610 unless 0x1428ed9a0 says it is already set. Missing map key throws (0x1456bf461). Ends with FUN_14387ac00 on +0x130 / +0x1b0. Better context needed: names of the +0x150 and +0x1d0 car groups.
